headline: Every child deserves a family, a school and a future.
intro: We bring health care, education and job skills to the poorest communities of Varanasi and Delhi, through local leaders who live there.

why.title: Every donation goes to the work
why.text: We have no paid staff. Our volunteer board covers the running costs.

why.title: We stay for the long haul
why.text: Children who came to Kutumb at three are now studying law, nursing and technology. Eight are in college or working.

why.title: Local leaders, trust by transparency
why.text: We work only with trusted local partners. We audit their books regularly and visit in person, so every dollar reaches the cause it was given for.

why.title: You see every result
why.text: Our partners report every year, and we publish the numbers in our annual newsletter.
